SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Son, isn’t your room spotless?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 兒子你看，房間很乾淨吧？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 部屋、すごくきれいになってるでしょ？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kamar anak Ibu bersih banget, kan?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Filho, não tá tudo limpinho no seu quarto?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: پسرم اتاقتو ببین چقدر برق می‌زنه!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 말숙이가 너 없을 때 계속 쓸고 닦고 한 거야~
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Mal-sook kept cleaning it while you were gone~
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 末淑在你不在的时候一直扫来擦去的~
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 末淑在你不在的時候又是擦又是掃的～
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: マルスクがあんたのいない間ずっと掃除してくれてたのよ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Itu Mal-sook yang rajin nyapu sama ngepel selama kamu nggak ada~
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: A Mal-sook ficou limpando enquanto você tava fora~
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Mal-sook lo estuvo limpiando mientras no estabas!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: وقتی تو نبودی، مال‌سوک مدام داشت می‌سابید و تمیزش می‌کرد~

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 엄마 근데 얘 하숙비도 안 내는데
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Mom, but she doesn’t even pay rent here.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 媽，可是他也沒付房租耶
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: でも母さん、この子下宿代も払ってないんだから
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tapi Ibu, dia kan nggak bayar kos juga,
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Mãe, mas ela nem paga aluguel aqui.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Pero si ni siquiera paga renta,
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: مامان، ولی این که اینجا مفتی نشسته و کرایه نمی‌ده،

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그 정도는 해야 하는 거 아니야?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Shouldn’t she at least be doing that?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: そのくらいは当然じゃない？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: jadi wajar aja kalau bantuin, kan?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ela não devia pelo menos fazer isso?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿no es lo mínimo que debería hacer?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: حداقل باید همین کارا رو بکنه دیگه، نه؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hey! Why would we take money from Mal-sook?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 真是的！幹嘛跟末淑收錢！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: なに言ってんの！マルスクからお金なんてもらうわけないでしょ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ih dasar! Mal-sook kok malah ditarik bayaran!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ei! Por que a gente cobraria dinheiro da Mal-sook?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Ey! ¡¿Cómo le vas a cobrar a Mal-sook?!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: خفه شو ببینم! مگه ما از مال‌سوک پول می‌گیریم؟!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You should be saying “thank you” for looking after you!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 人家在旁边照顾你，你就该说声“谢谢”！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 人家在旁邊照顧你，要說“謝謝”啊！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: そばで世話してくれてるんだから「ありがとう」って言うのが当たり前だろ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Udah dibantuin, kamu tinggal bilang “terima kasih” aja!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você devia era dizer “obrigado” por cuidar de você!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Con que te cuide y te ayude, ya deberías agradecerle!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: همین که دور و برت هست باید کلاتو بندازی هوا بگی دستت درد نکنه!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ugh, Dad, seriously…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: わーもう、父さんまで！まじか…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aduh, Ayah! Bener-bener deh…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ugh, pai, sério…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ای بابا، بابا! شما هم که همه‌ش طرف اونو می‌گیرین...

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 너 하여간 말숙이한테 하숙비 받기만 해!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: All you ever care about is charging Mal-sook rent!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你敢跟末淑收房租试试？！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 總之，你敢跟末淑收房租試試！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: お前はマルスクに下宿代払わせるなよ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Awas kalau kamu minta-minta uang kos ke Mal-sook, ya.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Tudo que você pensa é em cobrar aluguel da Mal-sook!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Más te vale no cobrarle a Mal-sook!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نشنوم یه وقت از مال‌سوک کرایه بخوای ها، فهمیدی؟!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 말숙이 있어서 이모 마음이 얼마나 놓이는지 몰라.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You don’t know how much peace of mind she gives your aunt just by being here.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 有末淑在阿姨心里可放心多了
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你不知道有末淑在，阿姨心裡有多踏實啊
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: マルスクがいてくれるからお母さんもどれだけ安心できていることか
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Padahal gara-gara ada Mal-sook, hati Ibu tuh jadi tenang banget.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você não faz ideia da paz de espírito que ela dá pra sua tia só de estar aqui.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Me siento tranquila sabiendo que ella está aquí.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اصلاً نمی‌دونی خاله چقدر خیالش راحته که مال‌سوک پیشته.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 엄마 아빠 다시 출장 가봐야 되니깐
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Since Mom and Dad have to head off on another business trip,
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 爸爸妈妈现在又得出差了
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: …さて、私たちはまた出張に行かないといけないからね
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ayah sama Ibu sekarang harus berangkat kerja lagi,
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Como a mamãe e o papai têm que viajar a trabalho de novo,
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Bueno, papá y yo tenemos que volver a salir de viaje,
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: مامان و بابا باید دوباره برن مأموریت کاری،

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: you take good care of the house, okay?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 家のこと、ちゃんと頼んだぞ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: jadi jaga rumah baik-baik ya.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: cuida bem da casa, tá?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: así que cuida bien la casa.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: حواست حسابی به خونه و زندگی باشه، باشه؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Got it?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いいな？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ngerti?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Entendido?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: فهمیدی پسرم؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: But I’m not even fully recovered yet.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: まだ全部治ってないんだから
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku kan belum sembuh total...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Mas eu nem me recuperei totalmente ainda.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Pero aún no estoy del todo recuperado,
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من که هنوز جون نگرفتم،

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 좀만 더 있다 가면 안 돼?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Can’t you stay just a little longer?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你們不能再待一陣子嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: もうちょっといてくれたっていいじゃん…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Boleh nggak kalian tinggal lebih lama?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não podem ficar só mais um pouquinho?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿no se pueden quedar un poco más?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نمی‌شه یکم بیشتر پیشم بمونین بعد برین؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 유만이 걱정하지 마세요. 유만이 제가 잘 돌볼게요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Don’t worry about Yuman. I’ll take good care of him.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 叔叔阿姨你们放心，我会好好照顾宥万的！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 請不要擔心宥萬，我會好好照顧他的
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユマンのことは心配しないでください。私がちゃんと面倒みますから
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Nggak usah khawatir soal Yuman. Biar aku yang jagain dia.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não se preocupe com o Yuman. Eu vou cuidar bem dele.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No se preocupe, señora. Yo me encargo de Yumán, lo cuidaré bien.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: شما اصلاً نگران یومان نباشین خاله جون، خودم چهارچشمی حواسم بهش هست!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Thanks, Mal-sook. We’re counting on you!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 末淑，謝謝你！就拜託你了！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: マルスク、本当にありがとうね。頼りにしてるよ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Makasih banyak ya, Mal-sook. Tolong jaga dia baik-baik!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Obrigada, Mal-sook. Estamos contando com você!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: قربونت برم مال‌سوک جون، سپردمش به خودت!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Alright, let’s get going, let’s get going.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: さあさあ、私たちは行きましょう
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ya udah, kita berangkat.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Certo, vamos indo, vamos indo.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: خیلی خب، بدو بریم که دیرمون شد!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Son, we’ll be back!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 行ってくるよ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Nak, Ayah sama Ibu pergi dulu ya!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Filho, a gente volta!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: پسرم ما رفتیم، به سلامت!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You’re really leaving?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ほんとに行っちゃうの？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Serius kalian mau pergi sekarang?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Vocês vão mesmo embora?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: جدی‌جدی دارین می‌رین؟!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’ll keep in touch and update you from time to time!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我会时不时联系你们的！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私が途中連絡しますから！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku bakal kasih kabar ke Ayah dan Ibu sesering mungkin!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu vou manter contato e te atualizar de vez em quando!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Los mantendré al tanto de todo.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من زنگ می‌زنم از وضعیتش بهتون خبر می‌دم خاله جون!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh~ yeah, yeah
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あぁ～、うん、うん
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Oh~ iya, iya
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah~ sim, sim
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آره عزیزم، فدات شم!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Why would you say that…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: なんでそれ言うんだよ…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ya ampun, ngapain ngomong itu...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Por que você tinha que dizer isso…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: چرا به مامانم اینا گفتی اخه؟...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Say what?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 俺が何だよ…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: A-aku apa…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Dizer o quê?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: چی رو چرا گفتم؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 내가 하숙비 안 내는 거 그거 왜 얘기하냐고
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: About me not paying rent—why’d you have to bring that up?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 为什么要说我不交房租的事
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 下宿代払ってないとか、なんでそれを言うの
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ngapain sih ngomongin kalau aku nggak bayar kos.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Que eu não pago aluguel—por que você tinha que falar isso?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡No tenías por qué decir que no pago renta!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اینکه کرایه نمی‌دی رو چرا جلو اونا انداختی وسط؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Who said you had to pay rent?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 誰が払うなって言った？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Lah, siapa juga yang bilang kamu harus bayar?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Quem disse que você tinha que pagar aluguel?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: کی گفته من باید کرایه بدم اخه پُررو؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: …Ugh, I’m hungry.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ……あ〜お腹すいた
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ah… laper.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: …Ugh, tô com fome.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آخیش... گشنه‌مه بدجور.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Want to eat? No, let’s drink!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 要不去吃饭？算了，喝酒吧！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 要不要吃飯？算了，我們喝酒吧！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ご飯食べる？ いや、お酒にしよう！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Makan aja yuk? Eh, nggak jadi, minum aja!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Quer comer? Não, vamos beber!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: غذا بخوریم؟ نه بابا، بیا نوشیدنی بزنیم عشق کنیم!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I can’t drink, I’m a patient.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 俺、病人だから酒はダメだって
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku kan pasien, nggak bisa minum.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu não posso beber, sou paciente.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من مریض احوالم، نباید لب به نوشیدنی بزنم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’m the one who wants to drink.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私が飲みたいの
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku yang pengin minum.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu é que quero beber.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من دلم می‌خواد بخورم، نه تو!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 빨리 나가서 편의점에서 맥주랑 안주 좀 사와.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Now hurry up and run to the store—get some beer and snacks.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 快点出去便利店买点啤酒和下酒菜来
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 快點去便利商店，買些啤酒和下酒菜回來
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ほら、コンビニ行ってビールとつまみ買ってきて
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Cepet gih ke minimarket, beliin bir sama camilan.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Agora anda logo e corre até a loja—pega umas cervejas e petiscos.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Anda, ve a comprar cerveza y algo para picar.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: زود باش برو سوپرمارکت چند تا قوطی نوشیدنی خنک با مزه بخر بیار.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’m still a patient.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 俺、病人なんだって
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku kan pasien!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu ainda sou paciente.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿No me tienes que atender tú a mí?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من پام تو گچه ها! بیمارم هنوز!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You’ve got one good leg left.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你还有一只脚可以用啊
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你還有一隻腳可以用啊
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 足はまだ一本残ってるでしょ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ya tinggal satu kaki kamu, masih bisa jalan lah.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você tem uma perna boa sobrando.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اون یکی پات که سالمه، بپر دیگه!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아..진짜 우리 엄마아빠는 널 왜 좋아하는 거냐.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Seriously… why do my parents even like you so much?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 哎…真不懂我爸妈为什么那么喜欢你
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 啊…為什麼我爸媽那麼喜歡你啊
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はぁ…ほんとにうちの親はなんでお前のこと気に入ってんのかね
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Astaga… kenapa sih Ayah sama Ibu suka banget sama kamu.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sério… por que meus pais gostam tanto de você?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No sé porqué les agradas tanto a mis padres...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: عجبا... مامان و بابام عاشق چیه این اخلاق سگی تو شدن واقعاً؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: If you go quickly, I’ll give you a kiss when you get back.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你快买回来我就亲你一下
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你快去買回來的話，我就親你一下
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 早く行ってきたら、チューしてあげる
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Udah, kalau kamu cepet pulang, aku kasih ciuman deh.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Se você for rápido, eu te dou um beijo quando voltar.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Si vuelves rápido, te doy un beso.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اگه فرز بری و بیای، یه بوس بهت جایزه می‌دم!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ha, come on…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はっ…バカ言え
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hah, dasar…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ha, qual é…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هه، برو عامو...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Who said I even wanted that?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 誰がそんなの欲しがるか
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Siapa juga yang mau ciuman dari kamu!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Quem disse que eu queria isso?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: کی اصلاً بوس تو رو خواست اخه؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ugh, unbelievable!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ〜もう！ほんっとに！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ya ampun… bener-bener deh!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ugh, inacreditável!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ایشش... چقدرم خودش رو می‌گیره!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Just go already!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いいから早く行ってきて！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Cepet pergi sana!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Só vai logo!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: زود برو بیا، معطل نکن!
